task: cme-2022-2024 - CME Group holiday trading schedules by product group, calendar years 2022, 2023 and 2024
coverage: All artifacts were retrieved on 2026-09-12 (UTC) and saved with their sha256 in /Users/agedvagabond/Developer/exchange-hours-research/holidays/raw/cme-2022-2024/INDEX.md; cmegroup.com answers 403 to this machine, so every document was read through the Wayback Machine's verbatim id_ replay of the operator's own bytes. Complete for calendar 2022 (all ten published U.S. holiday schedules plus the day after Thanksgiving), from CME Group's own per-asset-class Globex holiday spreadsheets at T1. For 2023, seven of ten holidays are sourced at T1 from CME's 'Holiday Schedule' one-pagers under cmegroup.com/trading-hours/files/ (New Year's Day 2023 comes from the last of the old spreadsheets); MLK, Presidents Day and Good Friday 2023 are unsourced because CME moved Globex holiday hours into the client-rendered trading-hours page for 2023 and published no document for those three. For 2024, four windows are sourced at T2 from Wayback captures of CME's own trading-hours service (Labor Day, Thanksgiving and the day after, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day, New Year's Eve), plus New Year's Day 2024 at T1 from the last one-pager; MLK, Presidents Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth and Independence Day 2024 are unsourced because the service returns empty event arrays for dates already past and the archive holds no capture taken before those days. Product groups covered as CME prints them: 2022 sheets - Equity Products (with a Nikkei line on the MLK, Presidents Day and Memorial Day sheets), Interest Rate Products, FX Products, one combined Energy/Metals/Softs/DME line, Grains and Oilseeds, Livestock, Cryptocurrency, Dairy, Lumber. 2023 one-pagers and the 2024 service - INTEREST RATE, EQUITIES, ENERGY, GRAINS, FX, METALS, LIVESTOCK, CRYPTOCURRENCIES, DAIRY, LUMBER, with Energy and Metals printed as separate lines. All instants are as printed: the 2022 sheets state 'All times are Central Time  ET +1  UTC +6' (or +5 in U.S. daylight time); the 2023 one-pagers state 'Trading hours are subject to change and are in U.S. Central Time unless otherwise stated'; the T2 service carries no zone field and is rendered by cmegroup.com in U.S. Central Time. Nothing was inferred from another year's pattern. Where a family's row is absent from a document, that absence is stated in the verbatim field rather than filled in. Every verbatim below is Central Time: the 2022 sheets print 'All times are Central Time  ET +1  UTC +6' (+5 in U.S. daylight time), the 2023 one-pagers print 'Trading hours are subject to change and are in U.S. Central Time unless otherwise stated', and the T2 service JSON carries no zone field and is rendered by cmegroup.com in U.S. Central Time.
